'''Frank Ruskey''' is a [[combinatorics|combinatorialist]] and [[computer scientist]], and professor at the [[University of Victoria]]. His research involves algorithms for exhaustively listing discrete structures, combinatorial [[Gray code]]s, [[Venn diagram|Venn]] and [[Euler diagram]]s, [[combinatorics on words]], and [[enumerative combinatorics]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Frank Ruskey|url=http://webhome.cs.uvic.ca/~ruskey|work=Department of Computer Science|publisher=University of Victoria|access-date=15 February 2019}}</ref>  Frank Ruskey is the author of the Combinatorial Object Server (COS), a website for information on and generation of combinatorial objects.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://combos.org/|title=The Combinatorial Object Server++|website=combos.org|access-date=2019-05-30}}</ref>

==Selected publications==
* {{cite journal|last=Lucas|first=J.M.|author2=Vanbaronaigien, D.R. |author3=Ruskey, F. |title=On Rotations and the Generation of Binary Trees|journal=Journal of Algorithms|date=November 1993|volume=15|issue=3|pages=343–366|doi=10.1006/jagm.1993.1045 }}
* {{cite journal|last=Pruesse|first=Gara|author2=Ruskey, Frank |title=Generating Linear Extensions Fast|journal=SIAM Journal on Computing|date=April 1994|volume=23|issue=2|pages=373–386|doi=10.1137/s0097539791202647 }}
* {{cite journal|last=Ruskey|first=F.|author2=Hu, T. C.|author2-link=T. C. Hu |title=Generating Binary Trees Lexicographically|journal=SIAM Journal on Computing|year=1977|volume=6|issue=4|pages=745–758|doi=10.1137/0206055 }}
* {{cite journal|last=Ruskey|first=Frank|author2=Weston, Mark|title=A Survey of Venn Diagrams|journal=The Electronic Journal of Combinatorics|date=June 2005|doi=10.37236/26|url=http://www.combinatorics.org/Surveys/ds5/VennEJC.html|access-date=1 October 2011|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20111011075509/http://www.combinatorics.org/Surveys/ds5/VennEJC.html|archive-date=11 October 2011|doi-access=free}}
